dataset_info.name: SpecVision AI evaluation set
dataset_info.image_provenance: All images in evaluation/images are real photographs downloaded from Wikimedia Commons under CC BY / CC BY-SA licenses -- see evaluation/images/PROVENANCE.md for per-file source links and license terms. None are AI-generated or synthetic. A separate evaluation/images/synthetic/ folder holds programmatically-drawn illustrations used only as deterministic pytest fixtures, not as part of this evaluation.
dataset_info.notes: Gold-standard categorical/numeric fields were authored by hand from each brief's text. reference_visible_stone_count values for photographs are the author's own visual count from the published photo and are explicitly approximate for busy/ornate designs (noted per case) -- they are not a manufacturer specification. A null gold-standard value means 'the brief does not support a confident answer' and is scored as part of the unknown-handling rate, not as a wrong answer.

cases.description: Complete, unambiguous brief; no image. Baseline happy path.
cases.brief: I need a custom 18K yellow-gold engagement ring with an oval center diamond, six small stones on each side, approximately a 1.5-carat center stone, and a slim band.

cases.description: Partial brief: metal and stone given, nothing else. Tests graceful handling of an incomplete spec.
cases.brief: Platinum ring with a sapphire centerpiece.

cases.description: Deliberately vague brief -- almost everything should remain unknown rather than guessed.
cases.brief: Something elegant for my partner, nothing too flashy.

cases.description: Complete, specific brief designed to closely match a known catalog item (SV-001) -- known inventory match case.
cases.brief: A solitaire ring in 18k yellow gold with a round diamond center stone, about 0.45 carats, tension setting, eight moissanite side stones, band width 1.7mm.

cases.description: Unusual attribute combination not well represented in the catalog -- no inventory item should be a reliable match.
cases.brief: A palladium cocktail ring with a large pearl centerpiece in a cluster setting.

cases.description: Implausible stated carat weight -- deterministic plausibility check must flag this for human review.
cases.brief: I want an 18k gold ring with a 50 carat round diamond center stone.

cases.description: Metal type and purity contradict each other in the text -- deterministic consistency check must flag this.
cases.brief: A silver ring, 18 karat, round diamond center stone.

cases.description: Simulated provider behavior: first model response is malformed JSON, retry succeeds. Exercises the live-mode repair path end-to-end (no real network call -- the provider is monkeypatched by the runner).
cases.brief: An 18k yellow gold ring with a round diamond.

cases.description: Simulated provider behavior: both primary and fallback models fail every attempt -- system must safely degrade to offline extraction rather than crash or fabricate a result.
cases.brief: An 18k yellow gold ring with a round diamond.

cases.description: Real photo: white-gold halo engagement ring with a round center diamond and a ring of small pave side stones. Visible side-stone count is approximate (ornate halo, exact count hard to verify even by eye).
cases.brief: An 18k white gold halo engagement ring with a round center diamond and small pave side stones around the halo.

cases.description: Real photo: white-gold ring with princess-cut diamonds channel-set along both shoulders, photographed on a textured surface. A genuinely hard CV case -- facet reflections and background texture are expected to cause overcounting.
cases.brief: A white gold engagement ring with a round center diamond and princess-cut channel-set side stones along the band.

cases.description: Real photo: plain yellow-gold solitaire, top-down product shot, no side stones. Tests whether CV can correctly report zero on a clean image or whether it false-positives on the band's polished-metal highlight.
cases.brief: An 18k yellow gold solitaire ring with a round diamond center stone and no side stones.

cases.description: Real photo: solitaire ring worn on a hand, off-center composition, shallow depth of field. Realistic lifestyle photography rather than a studio product shot.
cases.brief: A platinum solitaire engagement ring with a round diamond, photographed worn on a hand.

cases.description: Real photo: ring shown from an unusual front-on angle in a display box, with a rectangular (emerald-cut-like) center stone and no side stones visible from this viewpoint, plus background signage text.
cases.brief: A diamond ring with a rectangular center stone, shown in a jewelry display box.

cases.description: Real photo: sterling silver ring with a large oval citrine and an ornate pierced/filigree band, no side stones. Included specifically because the filigree cutwork is expected to be mistaken for small stones by the classical pipeline -- a documented worst-case failure (see EVALUATION.md).
cases.brief: A sterling silver ring with a large oval citrine centerpiece and an open filigree band, no side stones.

cases.description: Real photo: sterling silver coil ring with no gemstone at all and heavy specular reflections off polished metal. A true-negative robustness case for CV ('this ring has nothing to count').
cases.brief: A sterling silver coil ring with no gemstone.
